name: PhysFormer
description: An interactive AI application on Hugging Face Spaces.

paragraphs: PhysFormer is a unified diffusion transformer that generates 4D multi-object mesh dynamics directly in world coordinates for both rigid and elastic materials. Rather than predicting future frames in pixel space or rolling out next-step system states autoregressively, PhysFormer models motion as full-trajectory coordinate diffusion: given initial per-vertex positions, velocities, and material conditions, it denoises entire future vertex trajectories in one process, with mesh topology imposed at inference. This design enables physically plausible object-object and object-environment…
